mc-black-bear-023.front: How thick are a bear's fat and hair?
mc-black-bear-023.back: Fat 2.5 to 5 cm, hair 8 to 10 cm. It looks bigger than it is (70%).

mc-black-bear-024.front: Why are head and shoulder shots on bears a bad idea?
mc-black-bear-024.back: Dense, sloped skull deflects bullets; heavy shoulder bone (85%).

mc-black-bear-025.front: How many stomachs does a bear have?
mc-black-bear-025.back: One simple stomach and a short gut. It digests fibre poorly (90%).

mc-black-bear-035.front: How much bigger is a bear's nose lining than ours?
mc-black-bear-035.back: About 100 times the area (70%, North American Bear Center).

mc-black-bear-036.front: How far can a bear smell food?

mc-black-bear-037.back: Over twice as sensitive, with a higher range (70%).

mc-black-bear-038.back: Yes, and sharp up close; distance vision untested (70%).

mc-black-bear-039.back: Morning: air drifts uphill. Evening: downhill (80%).

mc-black-bear-040.front: When do you move on a feeding bear?
mc-black-bear-040.back: When its head is down and it feeds noisily. Freeze when it looks up (Tip).

mc-black-bear-041.front: A bear stands on its hind legs. Why?
mc-black-bear-041.back: Usually to see and smell better, not to charge (Tip).

mc-black-bear-042.front: Signs of an agitated, defensive bear?
mc-black-bear-042.back: Jaw popping, woofing, moaning, stomping, bluff charge (75%).

mc-black-bear-044.front: Fatal black bear attacks in BC?
mc-black-bear-044.back: Fewer than one every 3 years on average (75%, WildSafeBC).

mc-black-bear-045.back: Mostly solitary: sow with cubs, and the brief mating pair (90%).

mc-black-bear-046.front: How long do cubs stay with the sow?
mc-black-bear-046.back: Their first year and first winter; on their own by the middle or end of their 2nd spring (90%).

mc-black-bear-047.back: Boar 25 to 150 km2; sow 5 to 25 km2 (90%).

mc-black-bear-051.front: How often did spray stop black bears in the Alaska study?
mc-black-bear-051.back: About 90% (92% brown bears); 98% of spray carriers uninjured (80%).

mc-black-bear-052.front: Where do you carry bear spray?
mc-black-bear-052.back: On the chest or hip, never in the pack (75%).

mc-black-bear-055.front: When and how big are cubs born?
mc-black-bear-055.back: January or February in the den, about 400 g (90%).

mc-black-bear-059.front: Who dens first and comes out last?
mc-black-bear-059.back: Sows, especially with cubs. Big males den last (80%).

mc-black-bear-060.front: How long do interior bears den?
mc-black-bear-060.back: Probably 5 to 7 months; 3 to 5 on the south coast (90%).
